data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nand' meaning joy, happiness and 'Kisor' meaning delightful or charming. It is a name that signifies the presence of joy and delight in one's life. The name Nandkisor carries the meaning “Sweet, Delightful, Joyful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Nandkisor usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet, delightful, joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
